filter_params_by_predicate: filter Haiku parameters by module name or parameter name using a boolean predicate function
partition_params_by_predicate: partition Haiku parameters into two groups based on a predicate like separating weights from biases
merge_param_structures: merge multiple Haiku parameter or state structures into a single combined structure
traverse_param_structure: iterate over a nested Haiku parameter structure yielding module names, parameter names, and values
convert_to_immutable_dict: convert a nested dict of Haiku parameters into an immutable FlatMap for safe sharing
